Maintenance Procedures Information System
Introduction

This document was produced in 1996 under No. T-SS-004-r0 and was translated into Arabic under No. T-004-r1a. This document shows the technical inspection checklist for 125 MVA power transformers, denoted by the letter I1, to be carried out monthly, denoted by the letter M1, according to the manufacturer's instructions and acquired experience, in order to provide safety factors for personnel and to maintain the safe operation of the equipment.
Safety Precautions
Issue a work order approved by the competent authority.
Isolate the transformer and apply suitable earths on all sides
Wear a safety helmet.
Beware of falling into the oil collection pit when working on large power transformers
Tools, Equipment and Instruments Used
Helmet and safety belt
Work steps to be carried out
Look for any signs of oil leakage.
In the transformer oil tank as well as in the bushings.
Inspect and record the oil and winding temperature readings.
Inspect all the cooling fans.
Clean the cooling fan protection screens and leave no obstructions in them.
Operate the cooling fans manually and listen to detect any abnormal noise.
Inspect the transformer operating cabinet, make sure the door gasket is in good condition and that it closes tightly, and clean the inside of the cabinet with compressed air at a suitable pressure.
Repeat the previous inspection in step 7 on the tap changer cabinet.
Inspect the condition of the silica gel and replace it if the colour of one or more of its covers has changed.
Check the oil level in the lower indicator bottle of the silica gel vessel.
Check the oil level in all the bushings.
Clean all the bushings
Return the transformer to normal operating condition after the approval of the control centre.
